briefs.text: Wage protests halt production at 535 garment factories.
Protesters set fire to interim leader Yunus's ancestral home.
Trump hails the 'biggest' Philippine trade deal.
Quad foreign ministers meet for the first time in two years.
Xi holds sideline meetings with Sheinbaum, Fujimori and Kast.
Takaichi meets Putin, a first for a Japanese PM since 2022.
IAEA says North Korea extended its enrichment plant.
A magnitude 6.0 earthquake strikes Papua New Guinea.
Fiji declares a state of disaster over an El Niño drought.
Tame Impala sweeps the ARIA Awards with seven wins.
Cyclone Xavier strengthens to Category 5 in the Pacific.
Inflation climbs to 3.6%, a one-year high.
The coalition agrees a power-tax cut for households.
Germany pledges air defences and F-16 arms for Kyiv.
85 children are ordered out of the frontline village.
Ukraine hits two oil refineries inside Russia.
The bridge shuts after a third strike in four days.
Ethiopia and Eritrea mass troops along their border.
Amnesty says RSF drones killed 37 people in the city.
COP31 stays split over a fossil-fuel phase-out; Friday is the deadline.
The ICJ will deliver its Rohingya genocide ruling on Thursday.
The WHO keeps DR Congo's Ebola outbreak a global emergency.
Exxon's $30bn Rovuma LNG project wins approval.
Carney and Xi agree relief on tariffs.
House Democrats pick Jeffries for Speaker, 251-11.
Hegseth's surprise trip seals a US-Venezuela defence deal.
Rubio sees 'zero evidence' the power outages were an attack.
The top US egg producer will cull 1.8m birds over bird flu.
Nvidia falls 2.9% after its results; AMD jumps 5.3%.
Gold drops to a 14-month low, under $3,750 an ounce.
Sheinbaum says US trade talks are 'very far along'.
The Senate passes Lula's $10bn fiscal package.
Salvadoran troops raze a gang chief's house.
The US plans joint strikes on Colombian gangs.

dispatches.headline: Xi greets Trump on the tarmac as APEC opens
dispatches.summary: The two presidents met as the summit began; a three-way meeting follows Thursday.

dispatches.headline: Iran fires on a US base in Kuwait
dispatches.summary: Bahrain intercepted hostile drones in the sharpest escalation in months.

dispatches.headline: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth
dispatches.summary: At 10:16 UTC its signals took a full day to arrive - 25.9bn km out, a first.

dispatches.headline: Cyclone Akvan turns toward the Odisha coast
dispatches.summary: Nearly 50,000 moved to shelters; landfall due Friday.

dispatches.headline: Russia fires 141 drones at Ukraine
dispatches.summary: Kyiv says 126 were downed; five people were killed.

dispatches.headline: EU offers Kyiv a €45bn loan for 2027
dispatches.summary: Repaid only once Russia pays reparations, officials say.

dispatches.headline: Israel enters central Gaza, first since truce
dispatches.summary: Tanks crossed the Yellow Line; three people killed.

dispatches.headline: Fed minutes point to more rate rises
dispatches.summary: The Dow fell 561 points; the Nasdaq rose 0.4%.

dispatches.headline: Anthropic prices the biggest IPO on record
dispatches.summary: It raised $81.3bn at $83 a share; trading starts Thursday.

dispatches.headline: Van Gogh sells for a record $190.4m
dispatches.summary: The 1890 canvas set an artist record at Sotheby's.

dispatches.headline: GTA VI launches at midnight in New Zealand
dispatches.summary: First copies sold 13 years after GTA V.
